title: Naturalize the canopy-to-trunk junction and simplify hero actions
objective: Replace the rod-like upper trunk with a natural multi-fork transition, remove the four homepage section shortcuts, and place the two primary hero actions just above the crown-to-trunk boundary.
non_goals: lower trunk, cave, or root geometry
acceptance_checks: upper trunk reads as branching wood rather than a rod
lower trunk remains unchanged from viewBox y=980 downward
four section shortcut links and their CSS are removed
two hero actions sit above the visible crown boundary
title retains its accepted WRO-014 placement
Digitale DNA section start remains stable
local fragments remain reachable through the primary Schwerpunkte action

result.summary: The upper trunk now forms an asymmetric Y-junction with two tapering load-bearing limbs and matching internal grain lines. The four-link homepage wayfinder and all of its CSS are removed; the two primary hero actions sit 56px below the lead, immediately above the visible crown boundary.
checks: HTML, JSON, and YAML parser checks
one main and one h1 retained

reviews.orchestrator_semantics_accessibility_rev: pass: removing the redundant section wayfinder leaves the real Schwerpunkte fragment action and shared main navigation intact
reviews.orchestrator_visual_integration_review: pass: the asymmetric fork reads as branching wood, both actions sit above its boundary, and the WRO-014 title alignment remains stable
